data.name: Any% (No Explosive Glitch)
data.rules:
-Time starts when player movement occurs

-Time ends when the "E" interact disappears from the screen, starting the cutscene.

-No developer mode

-No third party software (cheat engine ect.)

-No Coop

-No explosives glitch

data.name: Co-op Any%
data.rules:
-Limit 5 players

-Time starts first player starts moving, However you may wait for the final player to load to start the run

-Time ends when the "E" interact disappears from the screen, starting the cutscene.

-No developer mode

-No third party software (cheat engine ect.)

data.name: Any% Glitchless
data.rules:
-No OOB

-No clipping through walls (including if you stay in bounds i.e.: entering Sahara)

-No Coop

-No third party software (cheat engine ect.)

-Time starts when player movement occurs

-Time ends when the "E" interact disappears from the screen, starting the cutscene.

-No developer mode

data.name: Bathrobe%
data.rules:
Time starts at player control
Time ends when Bathrobe is equipped
Runner can choose any difficulty
